title: Device verification of meadow-snapshot-pacing at aa8852d1: Note10+ pass, macOS VM first-scene clause not met, loop back through interphase amendment 3
context: After round 3 was green at aa8852d1 the devices were measured again on builds of aa8852d1 (evidence: ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/review/device/aa8852d1.md). Note10+ 10.15: PASS on fresh identically seeded installs, every bound met, all 26 attempts counted at throttle 0 (onboarding 32.83 against 33.66 fps, opens shown 1058 against 1108 ms, full quality 2633 against 2356 ms). macOS VM 10.14: the median first scene is 79 ms (session 1) and 125 and 120 ms (session 2, VM warmed up, three builds alternating) behind the unchanged build against the 50 ms allowed; the round-2 build 0289cbbf is 133 and 109 ms behind in the same session, so the miss comes from the round-1 frame-free first build, exposed now because the unchanged build is twice as fast in tonight's VM (first scene 213-221 ms, settle 463-466 ms, against 443 and 997 ms in round 2). In session 2 the change met every other clause and ran onboarding at 60 fps against 33. Both fix builds draw no frame for about 300 ms between the route's page build and the first scene; the cause of the slower frame-free build is not established. Windows 10.12: not measurable; the PC renders every build about fifty times slower than at 14:21 (idle Calendar frames 356-428 ms raster against 7.4-8.0 ms), the round-2 build as slow as the change, cause not established, measurements stopped per the PC guardrails. Android emulator 10.13: not run; vmlab refuses while the Note10+ is on the Mac's shared adb server.
options: Loop back: interphase:bug amendment 3 on docs/specs/meadow-snapshot-pacing.md with device finding D2 (the 10.14 first-scene clause) as the only concern, MSP label meadow-snapshot-pacing-amend-3, built with amend-3.zsh on mitosis/meadow-snapshot-pacing, then review round 4 and every device measured again on the amended build
Ship aa8852d1 and list D2 as a known risk
Wait for the owner to restart the PC and unplug the Note10+ so 10.12 and 10.13 can be measured before amending
option_reasons: D2 is a confirmed failure of a spec criterion on the device the spec names, reproduced in two sessions, and the pipeline sends every confirmed blocker back to interphase; every device is measured again on the amended build anyway, so the Windows and emulator checks lose nothing by waiting for it
Shipping would open a pull request whose acceptance criterion 10.14 is measured NOT MET, a macOS first-scene regression against the owner's goal that the Meadow performs as before or better
The owner is away from both machines; the amendment can run meanwhile, and measuring 10.12 and 10.13 on aa8852d1 would only be repeated on the amended build
outcome: Loop back with amendment 3. The concern is D2 in review/device/aa8852d1.md. Then amend-3.zsh plan-only and build, merge into mitosis/meadow-snapshot-pacing, review round 4 with previous_head aa8852d1, and measure 10.12 to 10.15 on the amended build: Windows once the PC renders normally (owner to check or restart it), the emulator once the Note10+ is off the Mac's adb.
